sign_top: Wild Spirlings nest in the ferns.
Walk through them and one may step out.

lines: Wedged behind the rock: two Kin Charms!
Just moss behind the rock now.
Your partner gets Energy back every turn.
If it runs dry, let it rest a turn. No shame in that!
I'd love to see a Zephlet up close. They tumble past too fast on the ridge.
Your Zephlet nearly blew my hat off. Worth it!
You look new at this. Take these!
Bonding works best when a Spirling is worn down.
Listen to its call and echo it back, and it may trust you.

imme: Imme: Out of Energy? Rest for a turn. Your Spirling gets it back.
imme_intro: Imme: I'm still learning too! Let's practise together.
Imme: Tip: when your Energy runs low, pick Rest and catch your breath.
imme_defeat: Imme: You rested at the right time. I'll remember that!
joss: Joss: Stages stack up. Guard twice and nothing gets through.
joss_intro: Joss: My Shalebat digs in. Watch its Guard climb!
joss_defeat: Joss: Even a wall cracks. Well hit.
